domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: tofler.in company page returned 404, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403, importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge, and the web_search backend was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. Company site https://www.steelbirdhelmet.com/ shows only a retail catalogue and dealer/store locator ("Trusted by millions of riders across India") — a claim, not a supply record. No domestic supply record verified.
note: Export is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with HS 65061090 (helmets) and B/L numbers, destinations Chile and Sri Lanka, plus recurring buyer lanes to UAE, Italy and Maldives — so the declared HS 650610 matches the actual shipped goods; no HS correction needed. Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey claims 632 shipments / 14 trading partners / 25 ports, but only 5 shipment rows and 5 buyer rows are visible without a paid subscription, so the 632 figure is a platform counter, not independently verified. Domestic supply: no traces of supply records found in accessible public sources — status unknown, not confirmed; revenue and export volume figures are null because no public figure was retrievable. Note the company is a helmet manufacturer (HS 650610), not construction/DIY as claimed in the input industry field.
